description: This file defines the NotebooksViewHolder class, which is a RecyclerView.ViewHolder subclass used for binding notebook data to UI elements in a RecyclerView. It handles user interactions such as clicks and long presses, and updates the UI based on the notebook data and selection state.

classes.name: NotebooksViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder that manages the display and interaction of notebook items in a list.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the notebook in the UI.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a Notebook object to the ViewHolder, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: runPayloads
methods.description: Updates the UI based on payloads indicating what has changed in the notebook data.

methods.name: onSelectedStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect the selection status of the item.
